title: Existence of the pointed local map between strict-henselization colimits
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], $\bar t:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to T$ a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and $\bar s= g\circ\bar t$. The algebra structures of both point residue fields [def-weil-residue-field] on $\Omega$ are exactly their geometric-point embeddings. Let $C_S,C_T$ be their chosen strict-henselization colimits [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-limit], equipped with local-ring structures, and let $K_S,K_T\subset\Omega$ be the corresponding relative separable closures [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Suppose $\sigma_S:C_S/\mathfrak m_S\simeq K_S$ and $\sigma_T:C_T/\mathfrak m_T\simeq K_T$ are ring equivalences whose induced maps $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}C_S$ and $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}C_T$ have every specified pointed-neighbourhood factorization. There exists a local ring map $h:C_S\to C_T$ [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism] satisfying $j_S\circ\operatorname{Spec}h=g\circ j_T$ for the canonical structural maps [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselization-structural-map] and $\iota_S\circ\sigma_S\circ\operatorname{res}_S=\iota_T\circ\sigma_T\circ\operatorname{res}_T\circ h$ as maps to $\Omega$. This lemma asserts neither uniqueness of $h$ nor its compatibility with arbitrary neighbourhood morphisms.

proof.text: Transport the canonical small affine limit cone across the affine spectrum isomorphisms and extend it along the initial inclusion into all pointed etale neighbourhoods. Each extended leg is a chosen affine leg followed by a pointed refinement. Its composite with the structural map is the canonical structural morphism, and composing it with the supplied Omega-point gives the neighbourhood's marked point. This is the fully proved private fullPointedStrictHenselizationCone helper; no henselianity is used.

Pullback along g sends a pointed S-neighbourhood (V,v) to the etale T-neighbourhood V x_S T, marked by pullback.lift v barT using hbar. The pullback map of a neighbourhood morphism preserves this point, by pullback extensionality. The legs of the full T-cone at these pullbacks followed by their first projections form a cone on the full S-neighbourhood diagram: its naturality is the pullback first-projection equation and T-cone naturality. Use the S-limit lift to obtain f.

Compose a cone leg with its neighbourhood structure map. The pullback condition and the full T-cone structural equation prove f followed by the S structural map equals the T structural map followed by g. To prove the pointed equality pT followed by f equals pS, apply limit hom_ext. After the limit fac equation, the T-cone pointed equation reduces each component to pullback.lift_fst, and the S-cone pointed equation gives the other side.

Use Spec.preimage on f. Spec.map_preimage gives its scheme map and hence its structural equality. Faithfulness of Spec translates the pointed equality to psiS = psiT composed with h. The map psiS, a residue quotient followed by maps between fields, is local. Thus psiT composed with h is local, and Mathlib isLocalHom_of_comp proves h local. Return h and these three properties, with the original signature unchanged.
